name: Power Sweep Right w/ Boot Fake
situation: 1st & 10, own 32, after a sweep left gain

summary.motive: Use the sweep's identical picture to drag all eleven defenders right, then attack the abandoned backside with a counter-bootleg.
summary.whyItWorks: The carry-out fake holds every run-fit defender for two seconds; when the quarterback reverses, the backside contains are chasing the sweep and cannot recover.
summary.failureMode: The backside end stays home instead of chasing the sweep, meeting the bootleg in the lane before the quarterback can set.

beats.title: 1. The Identical Sweep Picture
beats.text: Both guards pull and the halfback crosses for the same deep handoff as the base Power Sweep Left — the defense has no pre-snap reason to expect anything different.

beats.title: 2. The Full Carry-Out
beats.text: The quarterback pulls the ball only after selling the complete mesh, keeping his shoulders square to the sweep for two full steps while every linebacker flows right.

beats.title: 3. The Counter Reversal
beats.text: The quarterback plants and reverses into the boot lane behind the left end's hinge. The entire defensive flow is now running away from the ball.

beats.title: 4. Open Grass Behind the Flow
beats.text: The quarterback sets his feet in the vacated backside with the free safety still recovering — every receiver-side option is now against single coverage.

relations.tell: The quarterback keeps the ball after the mesh — on the true sweep he is empty-handed within one step.
